steps: We usually celebrate New Year with my family. My grandparents come to visit us. My mother cooks special dishes — roast chicken and traditional salads. We decorate the tree and give presents at midnight. At school we have a New Year party with games and a concert.

steps: «Язык тела» (body language) — это жесты, позы и мимика, с помощью которых люди общаются без слов.

steps: 1) Body language means gestures, postures and facial expressions.
